description: Add an inbound rule to an Access Control Group

accessControlGroupNo.description: ACG number to add rule to (required)

accessControlGroupSequence.description: Access source ACG number (alternative to ipBlock). Cannot be used with ipBlock.

ipBlock.description: Access source IP block in CIDR format (e.g., 0.0.0.0/0). Cannot be used with accessControlGroupSequence.

portRange.description: Allowed port range (e.g., 22, 1-65535). Required if protocol is TCP or UDP.

protocolTypeCode.description: Protocol type code (TCP, UDP, ICMP, or 1-254 protocol number)

name: ncloud_add_acg_inbound_rule
